note: Trigg County has no countywide zoning (planning commission fact sheet). The City of Cadiz zones its territory, but its zoning map is published only as a static PNG image (ctcplanning.com) and a paper copy at City Hall; no queryable ArcGIS or WFS zoning districts layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online, the state portal, or PADD's GIS pages. Cadiz's zoning text is online (codelibrary.amlegal.com) but no polygon service exists.
